instrument: Worst-of Autocallable Note on NVDA / MSFT / AVGO (60% barrier)
headline: Tech worst-of note now trades within 10% of its 60% barrier
description: After the overnight fall in technology shares, the weakest underlying of this note is about 8% above its knock-in barrier. If it closes below the barrier, capital protection at maturity is lost.

headline: Partner Bank A calls its 5.875% USD perpetual at par on 12 November 2026
description: Partner Bank A issued a call notice: holders will be repaid at par on 12 November 2026. The bond had traded around 96 because the market expected the call to be skipped.

narrative.title: Partner bank issues call notice on a USD perpetual bond
narrative.whatHappened: Partner Bank A issued a call notice for its 5.875% USD perpetual bond. Holders will be repaid at par on 12 November 2026. The bond had traded around 96, as the market expected the call to be skipped.
narrative.whyItMatters: Holders gain about 4% as the price moves to par, but the 5.875% coupon stops on the call date. The proceeds need to be reinvested, at a time when the house view prefers the short end.
narrative.clientSummary: Partner Bank A has announced that it will repay its 5.875% USD perpetual bond in full on 12 November 2026. The bond had been trading below its face value, so its price has risen to reflect repayment at par.
narrative.clientTalkingPoint: This is a factual corporate action. No instruction is needed from you for the redemption itself, which is processed automatically by the custodian bank.
narrative.clientNextStep: Decide how to reinvest the redemption proceeds, which are expected on 12 November 2026.
narrative.clientNextStepDiscretionary: We will reinvest the redemption proceeds, expected on 12 November 2026, in line with your mandate and confirm the change to you.
